mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1%) compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate financing costs remain suppressed.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals labor market deterioration, prompting central bank policy accommodation that drives positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days as risk assets rebound.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1520) and retail sales (RSAFS < 553000) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1520 and RSAFS < 553000.
